title: The Orchard of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Edmund Hartwell
blurb: Ada Okafor, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
